{{Quote|We are all two-faced beings, divided by the Force and fated for eternity to search out our hidden identities.|Shassium|<ref name="DP" />}}
'''Shassium''' was an ancient [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]]. In [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], Shassium's words came to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] mind while [[Gender/Legends|he]] was listening to a speech being given by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="DP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shassium was mentioned in [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], a novel by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="DP" />
